mapper.select: SELECT op.order_id AS order_id, op.company_id AS company_id, op.user_id AS user_id, op.enterprise_id AS enterprise_id, op.activity_id AS activity_id, op.if_share_store AS if_share_store, op.close_modify_time AS close_modify_time, op.purchase_mode AS purchase_mode, act.name AS activity_name, ep.name AS enterprise_name, CASE WHEN epe.id IS NOT NULL THEN 'employee' WHEN epr.id IS NOT NULL THEN 'relative' ELSE '' END AS type, CASE WHEN epe.id IS NOT NULL THEN epe.name WHEN epr.id IS NOT NULL THEN epe2.name ELSE NULL END AS employee_name FROM employee_purchase_orders_rel_activity op LEFT JOIN employee_purchase_activities act ON act.id = op.activity_id LEFT JOIN employee_purchase_employees epe ON epe.enterprise_id = op.enterprise_id AND epe.user_id = op.user_id LEFT JOIN employee_purchase_relatives epr ON epr.enterprise_id = op.enterprise_id AND epr.user_id = op.user_id AND epr.activity_id = op.activity_id LEFT JOIN employee_purchase_employees epe2 ON epe2.id = epr.employee_id LEFT JOIN employee_purchase_enterprises ep ON ep.id = op.enterprise_id WHERE op.company_id = #{companyId} AND op.order_id = #{orderId} LIMIT 1
